title: Prompt to Bench: language models as a no-CAD entry point to 3D printing for biology labs
description:
A living paper, a student tutorial, a library of 16 geometry-checked parametric OpenSCAD designs for biology labs (benchware, tools, quick fixes and parts of full instruments), and Prompt-to-Bench-16, a benchmark that scores language-model-written OpenSCAD against hidden geometric checks, with HO-16, a held-out set of 16 more tasks written blind. Includes evaluations of open-weight models offline on a CPU-only laptop and on a desktop NPU box, with hosted Claude models as a reference; fine-tuning, prompt and pre-registered small-model experiments; a language ablation (Spanish, Hindi, Swahili); and a first set of parts to print and measure.
